review_candidates.title: Associate Project Manager, High Voltage
review_candidates.description: About IPX Power IPX Power, a clean energy company, develops, owns, and operates some of the world’s largest energy resources, delivering affordable, reliable power to utilities and other customers. We’re in a rapid growth phase with 4.3 GW of solar PV and 8.8 GWh of battery storage in construction or operation, with more projects under various stages of development. IPX is a profitable, well-capitalized, independent power producer that has delivered billions of dollars of industrial-scale clean energy infrastructure. The company was recently formed as a spin-out of Intersect, as a result of their recent acquisition by Google. IPX is supported by long-standing existing investors TPG Rise Climate, Climate Adaptive Infrastructure, and Greenbelt Capital Partners. IPX is rooted in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and operational excellence. We’re building and operating billions of dollars in assets and seeking people eager to develop, build, and operate one of the world’s largest renewables and storage portfolios. About This Role The HV Associate Project Manager, Construction will oversee and execute the construction phase of standalone and co-located utility-scale High Voltage (HV) projects. This role manages the complete construction life cycle of high-voltage battery storage assets—from Notice to Proceed (NTP) and site civil/electrical works through equipment delivery, mechanical completion, commissioning support, and final commercial operation (COD). You will manage EPC contractors and high voltage original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), ensure strict adherence to project schedule and budget, enforce site safety and technical compliance, and drive projects across key milestones. Internally, this role requires close coordination across Development, Engineering, Procurement, Origination, Finance, Legal, and Operations. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing multiple large-scale infrastructure projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Team Overview The Construction team is responsible for the successful execution of IPX Power’s utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America. The team works closely with Development, Engineering, Procurement, Origination, Finance, and Operations to manage EPC contractors, oversee project schedules and budgets, and ensure projects are delivered safely and efficiently. Project Managers coordinate owner-side consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to drive projects from construction start through commissioning and operational handover while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and performance. What You’ll Do Construction Execution & Delivery: Oversee the day-to-day construction execution of 500kV substation and transmission line facilities, managing site civil works, pad foundations, steel erection and installation of high voltage electrical equipment, coordination of integration with owner-furnished equipment, and balance-of-plant (BOP) integration through to Mechanical Completion, energization, and COD. EPC and OEM Contract Management: Drive and manage EPC partners and equipment OEMs. Enforce contractual scope, milestones, technical submittals, change order management, and equipment delivery schedules. Integration & Commissioning Support: Partner with the Commissioning, Electrical, and Engineering teams to transition the physical plant through initial energization, capacity/efficiency testing, grid integration, and commercial market participation. Interconnection and SCADA Coordination: Work alongside the Transmission Owner, ISO/RTO, and internal engineering teams to manage interconnection facility upgrades, SCADA/telemetry integration, and testing timelines. Budget & Schedule Oversight: Maintain tight control of project budgets, cost forecasting, cash flows, and schedule critical paths. Identify risks proactively and implement mitigation strategies. Operational Handover: Drive the transition of completed substation and transmission line, as-built packages, warranties, and technical documentation to the IPX O&M and Asset Management teams. Enforce Safety & Code Compliance: Maintain rigorous oversight of site safety, ensuring strict compliance with site-specific safety plans and local environmental permitting requirements. Internal Project Management: Serve as the central point of contact for internal cross-functional stakeholders. Coordinate with Owner’s Engineers to ensure engineering deliverables meet specs, review RFIs/submittals/IFC packages, mentor associate project managers, and present concise progress updates to executive leadership. What You’ll Bring Education (Preferred): Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience: 5+ years of construction management or project management experience on utility-scale energy storage (BESS) or major industrial power projects. Proven track record of serving as Lead PM or Owner’s Representative on at least two utility-scale high voltage construction projects from NTP through energization and substantial completion/COD. Expertise: Deep technical understanding of 500kV substation and transmission line architecture, CBC, NERC, WECC, CAISO, CPUC, and IEEE requirements. Solid understanding of EPC contracts, interconnection processes, and BESS degradation/guarantee structures. Tools and Skills: Advanced proficiency withGoogle Workspace, Slack, Bluebeam, and scheduling tools (Primavera P6 or MS Project). Strong ability to translate complex construction and technical data into clear reports for executive stakeholders. Exceptional leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills with high attention to detail. Total Rewards We care about your well-being, growth, and balance. Here’s how we support you: Compensation: USD $150,000 - $156,250 (total compensation includes base salary + bonus) Health & Wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision Time to Recharge: Unlimited PTO, plus two company-wide breaks (Fourth of July & end of year) Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus 6 additional weeks for birth parents; access to family planning support via Maven Mental Health: Free access to Spring Health which includes 5 free Therapy & psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through our physical health vendor, Wellhub+ Retirement: 3% non-elective employer contribution to your 401k or RRSP, ensuring your financial future is on the right track Perks & Extras: $150 monthly food stipend, $150 monthly reimbursement for cell phone/internet, pet insurance allowance, full home office setup and free access to UrbanSitter with $625 in quarterly paid company credits, Wellhub+, Perkspot, and One Medical Ready to take ownership of critical clean energy assets and help drive reliable performance? Apply now and play a key role in powering the transition to renewable energy.
